parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel made of wood, forming one side of the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides lateral support and stability to the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A second vertical side panel made of wood, forming the opposite side of the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural balance and rigidity to the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden bottom panel located near the base of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the lower structure and may serve as a base for drawers or storage.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A wooden leg supporting the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden leg supporting the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A third wooden leg supporting the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A fourth wooden leg supporting the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden back panel forming the rear enclosure of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural integrity and prevents items from falling out the back.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Vertical Front Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical front panel made of wood, forming the front face of the table structure.
parts.Functional_description: Holds the drawers and provides a finished appearance to the front of the table.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer located in the lower section of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing items; slides in and out of the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: Moves linearly along rails for opening and closing.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer located in the upper section of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items; slides in and out of the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: Moves linearly along rails for opening and closing.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden tabletop forming the upper surface of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a surface for placing objects or performing tasks.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.
